title: Review of c07's kstrail RD-twin finding: replicated on fresh seeds 7 and 8; the matched twin does not swim (max 1.1-1.5 BL), the 5x slower twin crawls and jams (max 1.8-2.3 BL), kstrail swims 12-13 BL
summary: Looked at the finding's README and sheets, then ran kstrail and both twins (world.py kh 0.05, world_slow5.py kh 0.01) on fresh seeds 7 and 8 with the finding's protocol (default 192^2, T=600). kstrail from noise: 27 and 23 long-lived tracks move >= 1 body length, max 11.9 and 13.0 BL, speed up to 0.51 (rerun_kstrail/seed7/sheet.png: isolated crescents swim through open space). Matched twin: 2 and 1 moving tracks, max 1.5 and 1.1 BL, speed <= 0.12 (round spots that replicate and sit). Slow twin: 7 and 8 moving tracks, max 1.8 and 2.3 BL, speed <= 0.26; its sheet shows crescents with a trail behind them that replicate and jam into a tiled band (rerun_twin_kh01/seed7/sheet.png t=339-600). Numbers in motion.txt. The finding's reading holds for this kinetic family.

observations.M: motion.txt and rerun_kstrail/seed7/sheet.png vs rerun_twin_kh05/seed7/sheet.png and rerun_twin_kh01/seed7/sheet.png: kstrail max 11.9-13.0 BL, matched twin 1.1-1.5 BL, slow twin 1.8-2.3 BL

controls_run.M: rerun_twin_kh05/ and rerun_twin_kh01/ (the finding's twins on fresh seeds) against rerun_kstrail/

not_checked: twin from noise (it goes extinct by construction of the threshold kinetics)
dt/2 or grid of the twin
verdicts.limitation: As the finding says, one bistable-threshold kinetic family and a planted twin; the twin's bodies are larger and replicate, so body-length counts and collisions penalize it. It conflicts with c01's kstrail-rd-twin finding (a different twin that matched the swimming), so 'taxis is necessary for M' holds only against this family.
